title: 1 killed, another wounded as firecracker ‘factory’ in Iligan explodes

blocks.text: ILIGAN CITY, Philippines — A 34-year-old man was killed while a woman was injured in an explosion allegedly involving chemicals used in firecracker manufacturing in Barangay Upper Tominobo here on Thursday afternoon, November 5, police said. In a spot report, the Iligan City Police Office (ICPO) said personnel of Police Station 2 responded to the reported explosion at around 3:30 p.m. in Purok 11, Caritas Village. Initial investigation showed that the man was allegedly mixing and experimenting with sulfuric acid, sulfur and other chemical ingredients for firecracker manufacturing when the explosion occurred.
